entities.name: Tatsunari
entities.description: Human ninja of the Mukotai Reckoners who rides a massive frog named Keimi and holds a grudge against kami.

entities.name: Keimi
entities.description: Massive corpse-swallower toad ridden by Tatsunari.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: City where Tatsunari rejoined the gang and terrorized people.

entities.name: Chishiro
entities.description: Samurai bonded to the kami Kaima.

entities.name: Kaima
entities.description: Kami bonded to Chishiro, later bonded to Tatsunari's sword.

entities.name: Order of Jukai
entities.description: Order whose spy Tatsunari befriended and whose sword hilt he bought.

entities.name: Boseiju
entities.description: Kami against whom Tatsunari had a special grudge.

entities.name: Far Corner
entities.description: Neighborhood at the edge of the Jukai forest.

events.summary: Tatsunari tries to steal a monk's coin purse and is caught by the kami the monk was channeling, making him crave a kami of his own.
events.quote: he was caught by the kami the monk was channeling.

events.summary: Using Order of Jukai codes, Tatsunari infiltrates a village, poisons monks and threatens Chishiro to force Kaima to bond with him; the kami chases him off.
events.quote: After the crazed kami rampaged through the village and chased him off

events.summary: He raises a corpse-swallower toad from the Towashi canal and becomes the Toad Rider.
events.quote: Tatsunari hopped on its back and became the Toad Rider

events.summary: Tatsunari leads the gang into Far Corner after a scout is killed by a kami.
events.quote: he led the gang into the neighborhood astride his toad.

events.summary: Chishiro kills Keimi and drives Tatsunari out; the kami in Tatsunari's sword reveals itself as Kaima, and Chishiro and Kaima begin to heal their relationship.
events.quote: the samurai Chishiro killed Keimi and drove Tatsunari out of the neighborhood.

relations.quote: Tatsunari is a human ninja member of the Mukotai Reckoners in Kamigawa .
The samurai and the kami could start healing and renewing their relationship.
